notes.title: Cold Shell dev progress 2021
notes.notes:
Hello!

First of all, I wish you all a happy new year!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35766255/5218ac7984e30411f1c43c5f509a086a02170710.png[/img]

I rarely post to Steam, but here is a Cold Shell update, to keep you informed.

[b]Main story quests[/b] are 100% complete now (but lack some small arts here and there). So yeah, one can start a game and walkthrough it all the way to the end credits. Here is a spoiler-free ending screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35766255/0aac43e1be252357f69334b9a8e5eab8ad4644f9.jpg[/img]

[b]Arena selection screen[/b] has the enemies' art updated. It has 9/10 battles ready now, i have to finish the last one. 90% done.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35766255/1c35d1a9878fb1633f8e83c0c5ba8c2884d23c9c.jpg[/img]

[b]Controls customization[/b] screen. I've heard more than once that people may want to change the controls. It's rather hard to implement (for a not-so-skilled person as myself). BTW for the default controls i've taken keys from emmm... a very popular, classic, top-down game that has melee combat, lakes of blood and drug references. But anyways, you will be able to select your own keys in the game, yay!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35766255/77149f3ee7e6235fa78d1342f6170895f5a6dd7a.jpg[/img]

For more transparency each [b]skill's description[/b] will now show you more info on damage you can deal (or HP you can heal). E.g.: instead of "strong bash" it's now "x4 DMG bash".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35766255/847026919d986b56a4203f61afeda78f59ea7264.jpg[/img]

I still have a few side missions to finish, bugs to fix, and boring technical stuff to do. But i can finally see the finish line ahead of me. Steam release date is updated to 2022 (obviously). And i will keep working towards finishing the development sooner than later.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35766255/1877b816c19ae78840ec22012cdd2f47d1bb2f3c.jpg[/img]

You can follow [url=https://twitter.com/Brutal_Muse_S]game's twitter[/url] for weekly (or so) updates on the development process.

Once again, happy new year everyone!

notes.title: Cold Shell dev progress
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I haven't posted on Steam for awhile. But the development of Cold Shell is going well. Let me give you a short list of current progress so far:
[list]
[*] - main story is 90% complete (i am focused on the final act 3)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35766255/f1cc27ff8c9dbb1e2ea16ee3c2ec6be9a5fd99ed.png[/img]
[*] - secondary missions are 60% done (they take less time to create, but are based on main missions assets)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35766255/b78416a32d6cee11be5e7d5c93f76e068d0de73e.png[/img]
[*] - room customization is 100% ready (all the art is ready and implemented in game)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35766255/3504dbbce83fc082ceff5e7f5c6e9fa5aaf12fb7.png[/img]
[*] - battle system, active skills and passives are 95% ready (it all works, but needs more balancing)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35766255/42b269cdbcbf0f20d6e941418a0a0ad2c27f8101.gif[/img]
[/list]

I am not certail about any release dates. And i hate giving any false promises. But I move steadily towards the release.

You can always check my [url=https://twitter.com/Brutal_Muse_S]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/coldshell]IndieDB[/url] where i keep posting stuff.

notes.title: Cold Shell hits top-10 Players Choice - Best Upcoming at IndieDB!
notes.notes:
Just as the title says. I still can't believe it myself.
Cold Shell made it to the top 10 Players Choice - Best Upcoming at IndieDB. 
I've added the medal to the awards section of the game's page with a link to the article, in case you want to check it out.

That is huge for a small indie dev like me. And i can't thank enough all the people who voted for Cold Shell. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35766255/788c3682f996200987e7aae7fa6f9669aebaa357.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35766255/173da75ff7a97a01eb3b7c4c14add4250c307a5a.png[/img][/url]

I keep working on the game. The COVID-19 landed a heavy hit on the development near the end of 2020 when the (only) artist got sick for 2 months. But he's fine now and we are returning back to normal.

I work on the act 3 (of 3 acts). Acts 1 and 2 are mostly dev complete, with some art pieces missing. I still can't name any release dates yet, because my previous fragile schedules were shattered by all that 2020 mess we all had. 

Stay well and stay cool.

* bridge boss could attack too fast on some systems, not any more

notes.title: Cold Shell demo description
notes.notes:
[b]Cold Shell[/b] demo will let you experience the start of the game and a portion of act 1 story missions. 
It will take you somewhere around 10 to 20 minutes to complete.

You will be able to try the main features of the game: melee combat with active skills, rpg system and room customization. 

If you are able to complete the story missions you will unlock a special challenge mission to test your skills even more.

notes.title: Progress update
notes.notes:
[b]Cold Shell[/b] now has a new trailer and screenshots!
I've updated the store page, to show you the development progress.

Old screenshots and video no longer reflect the current state of the game. A lot of work has been done, and much more needs to be done. You can see 2nd act (corporate offices) and updated character leveling options. 

Also, there is now a partial controller support label. The game can be played with a gamepad (i've used xbox), except for a couple of moments, such as entering the name of the character. If you are ok with the default name, then this is not a problem at all.

The game is about 70% ready. I hope to release it by the end of the year, if all goes well. Indie developers often have something going wrong, so no dates until I'm sure.

Add to wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080680/Cold_Shell/

notes.title: Cold Shell, a new game in development!
notes.notes:
A new game is in development!

[b]Cold Shell[/b] starts 7 years after Molten Armor's true ending. The northern empire has surrendered. The army and police are disbanded, firearms are withdrawn and banned. Spy drones fly over the streets, collecting information about all the inhabitants. Corporations are tearing the city apart with their skirmishes, and street thugs are creating chaos at night. And now the army of invaders has besieged the city and is not letting anyone through.

All these global problems don't worry the main character so much. You take control over an ex-cadet of a northern military school. Bash your way through street thugs, corporate mercs and rebel scum to save yourself and maybe the city in this arcade brawler rpg with room customization.

Wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080680/Cold_Shell/
